transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support, my name is Liam. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Liam, my name is Sorcha Gallagher. I work from a detached garage office in our back garden twenty meters from the house, and our home S-Net Wi-Fi signal does not reach into the garden office, constantly dropping video conferences with clients and making remote working impossible!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Sorcha. If I understand correctly, your home Wi-Fi signal is failing to penetrate into your detached garden office twenty meters away, causing continuous dropped video calls with clients. Before we examine your hub's wireless coverage and mesh extension options, could you please confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 22 Millfield Crescent, Harrogate, HG2 8PT, security PIN 7714.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Sorcha, that brings up your account details. What router model are you currently using in the main house?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It is the tall white S-Net Hub 5 situated in our ground floor living room.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query your Hub 5 wireless telemetry and radio power output?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Sorcha. Looking at the wireless diagnostics, your Hub 5 is transmitting at full legal EIRP power, but the exterior stone cavity walls and double-glazed garden doors attenuate the 5 GHz signal by over 35 decibels.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there a way to boost the signal across the garden lawn into the garage?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, our S-Net Intelligent Mesh Wi-Fi Pods are designed specifically to extend whole-home wireless coverage into garden studios and outbuildings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How does the mesh pod connect to the main router?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The mesh pod utilizes a dedicated 5 GHz backhaul channel or can be connected via an external Cat6 Ethernet cable.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I do have an exterior Cat6 Ethernet cable already running under the lawn from the house into the garage!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is an ideal setup: connecting the mesh pod via Ethernet creates a full-speed zero-loss wireless access point inside your office.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That sounds brilliant!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sorcha speaking, I run a freelance architectural consultancy, and I lost a twelve-thousand-pound commercial design tender yesterday because my video call froze during the client presentation! I was mortified and terrified that my business reputation is ruined! I have been crying with frustration all morning!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am querying our equipment logistics warehouse inventory right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Please do Liam, I am desperate to protect our architectural projects.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am truly sorry to hear that, Sorcha. Losing a twelve-thousand-pound client tender due to Wi-Fi drops is completely heartbreaking. While our engineering policy does not permit dispatching an onsite technician this evening to run external cabling, I will make sure we get a high-performance mesh pod dispatched immediately and set up so your client calls are rock-solid.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Liam, that reassurance means a lot.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously thick masonry and foil-backed insulation block high-frequency radio waves, so physical backhaul solves the issue permanently.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, the garage walls have heavy foil insulation.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Sorcha speaking, I have another critical presentation on Monday morning with the regional planning board! If this mesh pod doesn't arrive before Monday and work flawlessly, the planning board will reject our planning appeal and my client will sue me! I am under extreme pressure!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the high stakes and immense pressure of your Monday planning board appeal, Sorcha. To ensure you are fully protected, I am dispatching the mesh pod via Royal Mail Special Delivery Guaranteed by 1pm tomorrow, Friday, and I will include my direct desk extension so you can reach me if you need help plugging it in.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you so much Liam! Having it arrive tomorrow Friday gives me the whole weekend to set it up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Once the pod arrives, simply plug one end of your garage Ethernet cable into the pod's LAN port and connect the power adapter.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does the pod use the exact same Wi-Fi network name and password as the house?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, it clones your Hub 5 SSID and security key automatically, enabling seamless device roaming.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So my laptop will connect automatically without changing settings?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly: your laptop will roam seamlessly to the garage pod with full gigabit throughput.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That will make client video calls silky smooth.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have waived the standard fifty-pound equipment and express delivery fee on your account.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You waived the fee? Liam, you have been incredible!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Your dispatch consignment number is POD-SPEC-99120-H.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: POD-SPEC-99120-H, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The parcel will arrive before 1pm tomorrow, Friday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will look out for the postman tomorrow.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also noted your planning appeal deadline on your account record.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for understanding how crucial this deadline is.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Our technical support team is available twenty-four seven should you have any questions over the weekend.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That provides total peace of mind.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: We want to ensure your architectural consultancy thrives, Sorcha.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have completely restored my confidence today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before we finish up, what was that Harrogate postal address again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you right at the start of our call, it is 22 Millfield Crescent, Harrogate.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Sorcha, the delivery address is confirmed for tomorrow's dispatch.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you again Liam for your amazing help today.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It has been an absolute pleasure assisting you, Sorcha. Best of luck with your planning board presentation on Monday.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Liam, goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other broadband query I can assist you with today, Sorcha?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Liam, you have resolved everything perfectly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net broadband technical support, Sorcha. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye Liam.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net. Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
